notes: Maintainer SL7 local facts for agents and humans — not product defaults.
CI must not fetch Windows media (ADR-001). This path exists only on the maintainer host.
just check never mounts or hashes this ISO.
Weekly: GitHub Actions workflow health (Catalog B-release). SL7: just maintainer-check (quality + ISO advisory); writes .scratch/maintainer/last-check.json.
Optional sourceIso.sha256: (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 <path>).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() after you verify the retail ISO.
Task Scheduler example (run from repo root): pwsh -NoProfile -File tools/host/Invoke-MaintainerCheck.ps1
just smoke-maintainer uses samples/sl7.profile.json (same Primary install target). Requires .scratch/sl7.password.
Smoke default is offline OOBE (NIC until Supervisor). Online escape: positional ONLINE=1 or Invoke-SmokeElevated -OnlineOobe 1.
PowerShell: do not use just NAME=value overrides (WALL=180 binds to WORK). Use defaults, positional args (.scratch/smoke 180 1 45 0), or just smoke-maintainer-monitor.

sourceIso.description: Official Microsoft Windows 11 25H2 English (US) ARM64 retail/business Source ISO (DISM Languages en-US) for Smoke and Host Apply on SL7

smokeRecipeNote: ISO path is only for `just smoke` (positional). Maintainer ISO is fixed in this fixture; recipes call Invoke-SmokeRecipe.ps1.
